items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Cause I remember he used to come borrow the bass, but I was real small. But he was friends with my mom and my dad. Pajal.

ctx.x: Yeah. We might come across some other musicians, some of the older men that can remember playing with him too, you know, and if we, and if we.

Well I tell you now, I tell you who could tell you a lot about my dad, I think. Cause I remember he used to come borrow the bass, but I was real small. But he was friends with my mom and my dad. Pajal. Oh yeah. Played with George. You know, drag, slow drag. Oh yeah. Yeah, well now he can tell you. Yeah, he knew all about it. Yeah, he knew all about it. Yeah, yeah. He knew all about it.
He had a three string bass then.
